hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -q 'git push'; then if [ -d .github/workflows ] || [ -f .gitlab-ci.yml ]; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"This repo has CI workflows and a git push is about to run. Validate them locally with the wrkflw skill (wrkflw validate) before pushing."}}'; fi; fi
hooks.description: Remind to validate workflows with wrkflw before git push
